description_en: Calls the ListSets operation to retrieve a list of media sets
description_zh: 调用ListSets接口获取媒体集列表
name: ListSets

parameters.help_en: The marker from which the media sets are returned in alphabetical order. If you do not specify this parameter, the list is returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 从Marker开始按字典序返回媒体集信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回媒体集
parameters.name: marker

NextMarker.description_en:
The marker for the next request to list media sets. The remaining results that were not returned are returned in the next request.

This parameter has a value only when not all media sets are returned
NextMarker.description_zh:
下一次列出媒体集信息时以此值为Marker，将未返回的结果返回。

当媒体集未全部返回时，此参数才有值

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the media set was created

FaceCount.description_en:
The number of faces in the media set.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains face information
FaceCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的人脸数量。

当媒体集中存在人脸信息时，此参数才有效

ImageCount.description_en:
The number of images in the media set.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains images
ImageCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的图片数量。

当媒体集中存在图片时，此参数才有效

ModifyTime.description_en:
The time when the media set was last modified.

If the media set has not been updated since it was created, the modification time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
媒体集的修改时间。

创建媒体集后，如果未更新过媒体集，则媒体集的修改时间和媒体集的创建时间相同

SetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the media set

SetName.description_en:
The display name of the media set.

If this parameter was not specified when the media set was created, an empty value is returned
SetName.description_zh:
媒体集的显示名称。

如果创建媒体集时未设置此参数，则返回值为空

VideoCount.description_en:
The number of videos in the media set.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains videos
VideoCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的视频数量。

当媒体集中存在视频时，此参数才有效

VideoLength.description_en:
The total video duration in the media set. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is valid only when the media set contains videos
VideoLength.description_zh:
媒体集中的视频时长，单位为秒。

当媒体集中存在视频时，此参数才有效
